string.text: Operation
Got serious work? Not for one man - for a squad.
I'm in. Where do we muster?
Not now.
Stage: muster. Go to the muster point - %s. The squads join you when you get there.
Stage: assault. Target: %s (%d of %d). Enemies at the target: %d. It counts once the area is clear and you are close.
Stage: prepare the defense. Take positions at %s. The attack is coming soon.
Stage: defense. Hold %s. Attackers left: %d.
Zone Operations (Mixon)
Enable operations
Faction commanders offer operations in dialogue.
Reward multiplier
Multiplies the money reward for operations.
Extra squads
Squads added to allies in an assault and to attackers in a defense.
Operation Yanov

Freedom sits on Yanov like it's home. Enough. I'll give you two veteran squads, you lead them. Loki and his trader are already pulling out to the Warehouses - they smell trouble. Clear the station and Yanov is ours, Duty will hold it. Forty thousand and my respect.
Duty: the squads are moving to Jupiter. Muster point - %s. They won't start without you.
Duty: everyone is here. Forward, to %s! Clear the station.
Duty: sector clear. Next target - %s.
Duty: Yanov is ours! The garrison takes its posts. Reward: %d RU.
Duty: the operation failed. Fall back. We'll try again when we regroup.
Defense of Yanov

Listen, brother. Our guys near the Bar heard it - Duty is gathering men for Yanov. They think we got lazy here. They'll be here in a couple of hours. Shall we greet them? Twenty-five thousand and a bottle from my stash.
Freedom: Duty will reach Yanov in about %d h. Take your positions.
Freedom: Duty is attacking Yanov! Everyone, to arms!
Freedom: we held! Duty fell back. Reward: %d RU.
Freedom: we couldn't hold Yanov... Falling back to the Warehouses.
Swamp Cleanup
The renegades are back in the swamps. They rob our guides and shoot people in the back. Take two squads and go through their camps one by one. Twenty thousand, and the swamps are ours again.
Clear Sky: the squads are moving out. Muster point - %s.
Clear Sky: here we go. First camp - %s.
Clear Sky: camp cleared. Next one - %s.
Clear Sky: the renegades are gone, our posts are set. Reward: %d RU.
Clear Sky: the cleanup failed. Back to base.
Operation Valley
The bandits in Dark Valley have lost all fear. Orders are: clear their forward positions. I give you two sections, you are in command. Thirty thousand on completion. Questions? No questions.
Military: the sections are moving. Muster point - %s.
Military: begin the operation. First target - %s.
Military: position cleared. Next target - %s.
Military: operation complete, the positions are ours. Reward: %d RU.
Military: the operation failed. Withdraw.
%d m from %s
Duty: a convoy with the commandant, a quartermaster and a mechanic has set out for %s.
Duty: Colonel Mixon, the quartermaster and the mechanic have arrived at %s. The commandant has work for stalkers.
Colonel Mixon
A Duty legend, commandant of the Yanov garrison. Formerly lead engineer of a Moscow institute of space instrumentation.
Freedom's Remnants
Drive out the Freedom squad dug in near Yanov.
Loki left, but not all of his men. One squad dug in right under the garrison's nose, waiting for their friends. They will wait in vain. Go and finish it.
Clean work. Freedom doesn't even have spotters on Jupiter now. Take your pay.
Mutant Hunt
Exterminate the mutant pack near Yanov.
A pack has made a den near the station. My men can't sleep for the howling. Destroy it - that is what Duty is for.
One pack fewer. Good. The Zone did not get our men tonight.
Wanted by Duty
Colonel Mixon has ordered me to find and eliminate a target.
There is a man walking the Zone who has earned a bullet from Duty. Find him and close his account.
The order is carried out. Duty does not forget those who help it.
%s for the Colonel
Colonel Mixon needs a rare weapon: %s.

I need a sample of a rare weapon. Not for a collection: I take such things apart and learn how they were made. A Gauss rifle, silent sniper rifles, assault rifles Duty's stores never see. Find one and I'll pay like for an artifact.
Look for this: %s. A working piece, not scrap.
Now that's a thing. I've never held one of these. The money is yours - and thank you, stalker.
%s for HQ
Colonel Mixon wants %s for Duty headquarters.
Headquarters wants samples from the north. The scientists on Rostok pay for them, and so do we.
Find me %s. Don't take it from my men - find it in the anomalies.
That is a fine specimen. HQ will be pleased. Take your reward.
Colonel, sir, may I have a word?
Go ahead. Keep it short, stalker: I have a garrison to run and Jupiter outside the walls.
Tell me about yourself, Colonel.

I'm not a soldier, stalker. I'm an engineer. Aviation institute with honours, then a closed research institute in Moscow - space instrumentation. Satellite sensors, navigation systems for aircraft. At twenty-six I ran my own department and had a higher clearance than my director. They called me a genius. I just never went home until the device worked.
How did an institute engineer end up in the Zone?

In two thousand six, after the second blast, our institute got an order: adapt orbital gravimeters to find anomalies. A satellite sees a gravity well from three hundred kilometres up - so why can't a handheld device see it from thirty metres? You can't test a drawing on paper - you need a proving ground. The Zone became the proving ground. They dropped our group at the Garbage: five scientists, two soldiers and me with crates of equipment.
And what happened?

An emission. Back then we didn't know how they begin. We hid in an old garage, and it turned out to be a trap, not a shelter. Only a sergeant and I survived - because I went down to the basement to fix the generator. A Duty patrol pulled us out. I did finish the detector. Its prototype still hangs on my belt.
Why did you stay with Duty?

Because the institute sent a letter: project closed, funding cut, come back. And Duty said: stay, we need a man who understands how this filth works. I stayed. Built the fortifications at Rostok, put up the radio relays, set emission sensors on the checkpoints, calculated routes for the supply helicopters. The ranks came on their own - for the men who came back alive. And 'Mixon' is from the institute days: give me any junk and I'll build a working device out of it.
What is the situation at Yanov?

We took the station from Freedom. Loki and his men went to the Army Warehouses, to Lukash - sooner or later they will try to come back. The Jupiter plant is full of mutants, zombies wander near Kopachy, and from the north the Monolith is probing the road. The scientists in the bunker nearby we need alive: their instruments and my sensors together are the best intelligence on Jupiter. Want to help - ask about work.
Why does Duty need Yanov?

Yanov is the last big junction before Pripyat. From here you see everything: the road north, the plant, Kopachy, the tunnel. Whoever holds the station decides what gets out to the people and what stays in the Zone. Duty swore to protect the world from the Zone. Freedom traded artifacts here. We stand here.
What is really going on in the Zone?

First there was the plant - eighty-six. Then in two thousand six it blew a second time, and the Zone was born: anomalies, mutants, emissions. Then came the stalkers, after them the money, after the money the guns. The army holds the perimeter, but the Zone keeps growing. Every emission redraws the map.
And the center? They say someone made it.

They say. There was one, Strelok - he reached the plant and shut down the Brain Scorcher. They say behind the sarcophagus sat a group of scientists fused with the Zone - the C-Consciousness. The Monolith prays to their Stone, though there may be no stone at all. Later the army tried to break through with helicopters - Operation Fairway - and half the machines went down right here, on Jupiter. I did not see it. But I have seen the wrecks.
Is the Monolith a threat to Yanov?

The Monolith does not bargain and does not retreat. They walk until they die and fear neither bullets nor emissions. When the Scorcher went dark the road north opened - for us and for them. That is why the towers run double shifts. And that is why I need stalkers who don't ask too many questions.
I have to go, Colonel.
Convoy Interception
Intercept an enemy convoy on Jupiter and kill the escort before it reaches its destination.
My sensors picked up a convoy. Loaded: medicine, electronics, ammo. It goes through our land, so it's our cargo. Intercept them on the way - whatever you find on the bodies, keep.
The convoy never arrived - someone will be short of ammo tonight. Good work.
Ambush
Meet an enemy strike group on its way to Yanov and destroy it before it reaches the station.
A strike group is coming at us from the far side of Jupiter. If they reach the station, there will be a fight in our yard. I want the fight in theirs. Pick the spot, meet them and put them all down.
They never saw Yanov. That's what I call defense.
Mercenaries on Jupiter
Destroy the mercenary group in the marked area.
Mercenaries work for whoever pays. And right now someone pays to get Duty off Yanov. I found their camp - go and cancel their contract.
Contract terminated. Their employer will have to hire new men.
Monolith at the Gates
Destroy the Monolith squad in the marked area.
Since the Scorcher went dark, the Monolith has been moving south. One of their squads dug in near us. There's no talking to them - they can only be stopped.
Fanatics don't retreat, but they die like anyone else. You did a big thing for Duty.
Sin
Find the Sin camp on Jupiter and wipe out every cultist.
Sin are cultists who pray to the Zone. They lead people into anomalies and call it a blessing. A squad of them is close. Duty doesn't tolerate their kind.
One cult fewer. The Zone will do without their prayers.
Bandit Raid
Break up the gang in the marked area.
Bandits smelled the change of power at Yanov and decided they can rob stalkers on the roads. Explain to them that they can't.
The roads are clean again. Stalkers will remember who cleaned them.
%s: Blueprints
Colonel Mixon is looking for technical documents: %s.

Scientists and stalkers hide papers in stashes that are worth a fortune: schematics, manuals, reports on artifact behaviour. The most valuable lie in rich stashes - the ones marked yellow. I need those blueprints: with them I'll build at Yanov what so far existed only on paper.
Find me this: %s. Look in the rich stashes.
What a find. I won't sleep tonight - I'll be reading. Take your reward, you earned it.
Rare Mechanisms
Colonel Mixon needs rare mechanisms: %s.
Hydraulics, life-support systems, firing mechanisms - things Duty's stores don't have and never will. I'll build from them what will save soldiers' lives.
Bring: %s. Intact, no rust.
Good parts. I already see where they go. Here.
%s: a convoy (%s) is moving from %s to %s. Intercept it on the way.
%s: a strike group (%s) is moving from %s to %s. Meet it before it reaches the base.
%s: someone beat you to it - the group was wiped out without you. Task failed.
%s: scouts spotted a camp (%s) near %s. Wipe it out.
Operation Checkpoint

Duty blocked the road to Rostok with their checkpoint on the Garbage and decides who walks and who doesn't. Freedom doesn't live like that. I'll give you two squads - lead them. Knock Duty off the checkpoint and put our people there. Thirty thousand and a barrel of the best beer in the warehouses.
Freedom: the squads are moving to the Garbage. Muster point - %s. They won't start without you.
Freedom: everyone's here. Go, to %s! Take the checkpoint down.
Freedom: sector clear. Next - %s.
Freedom: the checkpoint is ours! The road to Rostok is open. Reward: %d RU.
Freedom: it didn't work. Fall back, we'll regroup and return.
Freedom: a trader and a mechanic set out for %s under escort.
Freedom: the trader and the mechanic are in place, %s. The checkpoint is open for friends.
Operation Homecoming

Bro, they're sitting on my Yanov. My station, my bar counter. Duty thinks that once they hang a flag it's forever. Three squads and we go home. Ashot and I will come back as soon as it's clean. Forty thousand - and Yanov is free again.
Freedom: the squads are heading to Jupiter. Muster point - %s. They're waiting for you.
Freedom: let's go! %s is our station, we take it back.
Freedom: clear. Next target - %s.
Freedom: Yanov is ours again! Loki and Ashot are coming home. Reward: %d RU.
Freedom: Duty held the station. Fall back, bro. It's not over.
Operation Rostok

The checkpoint is ours - now the big one. Rostok. Duty's headquarters, their heart. Take Rostok and Duty becomes one faction among many instead of the Zone's warden. Voronin and his staff will leave for Zaton - we are not butchers. Three squads, four points: both checkpoints, Petrenko's HQ, Voronin's bunker. Seventy-five thousand - and your name will be remembered.
Freedom: we're going to Rostok. Muster point - %s. This will be a big fight.
Freedom: forward! First target - %s.
Freedom: the point is ours. Next - %s.
Freedom: Rostok is ours! Duty's flag is down, their staff left for Zaton. Reward: %d RU.
Freedom: Duty fought us off. Fall back to the checkpoint. Rostok can wait.
Freedom: a trader, a medic, a mechanic and commander Yastreb set out for %s under escort.
Freedom: our people are in place, %s. Rostok is free now.
Duty Patrol
Drive off the Duty squad near Yanov.
Duty is hanging around the station again, bro. Marching in formation, looking sideways, getting in people's way. Go explain to them that Jupiter is free land.
There, quiet now. Here, you earned it.
Beasts at the Gates
Destroy the mutant pack near Yanov.
Mutants started coming to the station. Stalkers are scared to go out for beer, and that's just wrong. Deal with it.
Nice. Now we can go for beer.
A Job for Freedom
Loki asked to find and remove a man who is in Freedom's way.
There's a guy who really wants Freedom gone. Make it so he's gone instead. No extra noise.
Clean. Freedom remembers good deeds, bro.
%s for Freedom
Loki needs a rare weapon: %s.

Listen, Freedom always had the best iron. And I want it to stay that way. I need a rare gun - something Duty never saw in their stores even in dreams. A Gauss, silent rifles, western guns. I'll pay well.
Find this: %s. Working, not junk.
Now that's a gun. You could take Rostok with this. Here's your money.
Artifact for Sale
Loki needs an artifact: %s.
Freedom lives by trade, bro. The buyer is waiting for goods and there are none. Bring me an artifact - I won't stay in debt.
Bring: %s.
Oh, a good one. The buyer will be happy. Here's your cut.
Someone Else's Convoy
Intercept an enemy convoy on Jupiter and kill the escort.
A convoy is going through Jupiter - ammo, medicine, electronics. Not ours. But it should be. Intercept it on the way, keep the cargo.
The convoy never arrived - someone's empty tonight and we're full.
Ambush on the Road
Meet an enemy strike group on its way to Yanov and destroy it.
Scouts saw a group heading for Yanov. If they arrive, there'll be blood in our yard. Meet them first.
They never made it. That's what I call freedom.
Military Patrol
Destroy the military patrol in the marked area.
A military patrol is sniffing around the roads to Yanov - counting our men, marking our posts. Tomorrow they'll come back with a helicopter. Make sure the report never reaches it.
No patrol, no report. The colonels will be guessing for a while, bro.
Monolith
Destroy the Monolith squad in the marked area.
The Monolith is pushing south. There's no talking to fanatics, and freedom means nothing to them. Stop them.
The fanatics are down. The Zone got a little freer.
Sin Camp
Find the Sin camp on Jupiter and wipe out every cultist.
Sin isn't freedom, bro. It's a cult that leads people into anomalies. They have a camp on Jupiter. Close it.
The cult is closed. Easier to breathe without them.
The Army Is Coming
Destroy the military squad in the marked area.
The army is crawling into the Zone again with its rules and machine guns. Show them this isn't their proving ground.
The soldiers pulled back. Freedom stands.
%s: Blueprints
Loki is looking for documents: %s.
Rich stashes - the ones marked yellow - sometimes hold papers worth a fortune. Schematics, manuals, scientists' reports. I need those: to sell or to use.
Find: %s. Look in the rich stashes.
What a find, bro. Here's your reward.
Rare Parts
Loki needs rare mechanisms: %s.
Our mechanics want rare parts - hydraulics, firing mechanisms, that kind of thing. The warehouses don't have it. Find it.
Bring: %s.
Great. The mechanics will be happy. Here.
Second group is going in from the other side, onto %s. Hit them at the same time!
Duty Patrol
Drive off the Duty squad near Rostok.
Duty is hanging around the factory again, bro. Marching in formation, looking sideways, getting in people's way. Go explain to them that Rostok is free land.
There, quiet now. Here, you earned it.
Beasts at the Gates
Destroy the mutant pack near Rostok.
Mutants started coming to the factory. Stalkers are scared to go out for beer, and that's just wrong. Deal with it.
Nice. Now we can go for beer.
A Job for Freedom
Yastreb asked to find and remove a man who is in Freedom's way.
There's a guy who really wants Freedom gone. Make it so he's gone instead. No extra noise.
Clean. Freedom remembers good deeds, bro.

Yastreb needs a rare weapon: %s.

Listen, Freedom always had the best iron. And I want it to stay that way. I need a rare gun - something Duty never saw in their stores even in dreams. A Gauss, silent rifles, western guns. I'll pay well.
Find this: %s. Working, not junk.
Now that's a gun. You could take Rostok with this. Here's your money.

Yastreb needs an artifact: %s.
Freedom lives by trade, bro. The buyer is waiting for goods and there are none. Bring me an artifact - I won't stay in debt.
Bring: %s.
Oh, a good one. The buyer will be happy. Here's your cut.
Someone Else's Convoy
Intercept an enemy convoy nearby and kill the escort.
A convoy is going through the area - ammo, medicine, electronics. Not ours. But it should be. Intercept it on the way, keep the cargo.
The convoy never arrived - someone's empty tonight and we're full.
Ambush on the Road
Meet an enemy strike group on its way to Rostok and destroy it.
Scouts saw a group heading for Rostok. If they arrive, there'll be blood in our yard. Meet them first.
They never made it. That's what I call freedom.
Military Patrol
Destroy the military patrol in the marked area.
A military patrol is sniffing around the roads to Rostok - counting our men, marking our posts. Tomorrow they'll come back with a helicopter. Make sure the report never reaches it.
No patrol, no report. The colonels will be guessing for a while, bro.
Monolith
Destroy the Monolith squad in the marked area.
The Monolith is pushing south. There's no talking to fanatics, and freedom means nothing to them. Stop them.
The fanatics are down. The Zone got a little freer.
Sin Camp
Find the Sin camp nearby and wipe out every cultist.
Sin isn't freedom, bro. It's a cult that leads people into anomalies. They have a camp nearby. Close it.
The cult is closed. Easier to breathe without them.
The Army Is Coming
Destroy the military squad in the marked area.
The army is crawling into the Zone again with its rules and machine guns. Show them this isn't their proving ground.
The soldiers pulled back. Freedom stands.

Find: %s. Look in the rich stashes.
What a find, bro. Here's your reward.
Rare Parts
Yastreb needs rare mechanisms: %s.
Our mechanics want rare parts - hydraulics, firing mechanisms, that kind of thing. The warehouses don't have it. Find it.
Bring: %s.
Great. The mechanics will be happy. Here.
Yastreb

Freedom field commander, callsign Yastreb (Hawk). Ex-paratrooper who walked out of the army and into the Zone eight years ago. Took Rostok with the strike groups and now holds Duty's old headquarters - not as a fortress, as an open door. Gives work to anyone who'd rather shoot at Duty patrols and Monolith than at loners.
Kholodny
Clear Sky's commander at the Jupiter checkpoint, callsign Kholodny (the Cold One). Calm as ice in any fight; Viking sent him north to hold the way to Pripyat and to keep the expeditions alive.
Renegade Den
Find the renegade camp nearby and wipe it out.
The renegades crawled out of the swamps and set up a camp near the checkpoint. They rob our guides and sell their guns to anyone. Find the camp and finish what we started on the Marsh.
No more den. The guides can walk the roads again.
Mutant Nest
Destroy the mutant pack near the checkpoint.
A pack has settled right under our windows. The scientists won't go out to the anomalies while it's there. Clear the way.
Quiet now. The expeditions can go out again.
A Name on the List
Kholodny asked to find and remove a man who is dangerous to Clear Sky.
There's one man who hunts our guides for money. I know his name and roughly where he is. Make sure he doesn't hunt anyone again.
Done. One less hunter in the Zone.
Samples for the Lab
Kholodny needs an artifact: %s.
Our lab in the checkpoint is finally working, and it's hungry. I need a specific artifact for the measurements - not for sale, for science.
Bring: %s.
That's the one. The geophysicists will be up all night. Here's your pay.
A Rare Gun
Kholodny needs a rare weapon: %s.
Our guides walk where the army doesn't dare - and they need guns to match. Find me something rare: a Gauss, a silent rifle, a good western gun. I pay well.
Find this: %s. Working, not junk.
Now that's a gun. It'll go to our best guide. Here's your money.
Someone Else's Convoy
Intercept an enemy convoy nearby and kill the escort.
A convoy is going through the area - medicine, electronics, ammo. It feeds the people who shoot at our guides. Intercept it on the way and keep the cargo.
The convoy never arrived. Our medics will be glad of the cargo.
Ambush on the Road
Meet an enemy strike group on its way to the checkpoint and destroy it.
Scouts saw a group heading for the checkpoint. If they arrive, the scientists will be in the crossfire. Meet them first.
They never made it. The lab keeps working.
Military Patrol
Destroy the military patrol in the marked area.
The army wants its checkpoint back. Their patrol is counting our men and marking our posts. Make sure the report never reaches the colonel.
No patrol, no report. Kovalski will have to guess.
The Monolith
Destroy the Monolith group in the marked area.
Monolith fighters came down from the north. They don't talk and don't take prisoners - and they walk straight through the anomalies we study. Stop them.
Done. The anomalies are ours to study again.
Sin
Find the Sin camp nearby and wipe out every cultist.
Sin has a camp nearby. They believe the Zone is a god and kill everyone who studies it. We study it. Go and show them where this ends.
No more sermons. The Zone goes on without its prophets.
Road Robbers
Destroy the bandit group in the marked area.
Bandits are robbing the loners our guides lead to the checkpoint. A guide whose people get robbed loses trust - and we lose guides. Clear the road.
The road is clear. The loners will come to us again.
Lost Documents
Kholodny is looking for documents: %s.
The checkpoint was full of research before the army came. Some of it ended up in stashes all over the Zone. I want it back.
Find: %s. Look in the rich stashes.
That's it. Years of work - back where it belongs.
Parts for the Lab
Kholodny needs rare mechanisms: %s.
Our instruments are falling apart. I need rare parts - the kind you only find in stashes or on the dead.
Bring: %s.
Exactly what we needed. The instruments will live another year.
The place is ours - but they will be back. Counterattack in about %d min. Take positions!
Counterattack in %d min.
Operation Factory

The swamps are ours - now we need a real base. The small factory on Agroprom: walls, a yard, a building you can hold. The army has packed it with soldiers. Four squads go with you, gate first, then the yard, then the building. Once it's ours they'll counterattack - hold it, and they'll have to talk. Sixty thousand.
Clear Sky: the squads are moving to Agroprom. Muster point - %s.
Clear Sky: go, to %s! Take the gate.
Clear Sky: sector clear. Next - %s.
Clear Sky: the army is counterattacking the factory! Hold the building!
Army (radio): Clear Sky, this is Agroprom command. We're pulling back. We agree to a truce - the factory is yours, stay off our roads.
Clear Sky: the factory is ours - our main base now. Reward: %d RU.
Clear Sky: we lost the factory. Fall back to the swamps.
Clear Sky: Viking, Arsenal, a mechanic and a barman set out for %s under escort.
Clear Sky: everyone is in place, %s. The base is working.
The Scientists' Bunker

Listen. Sakharov's people on Yantar are calling for help - their sensors picked up something strange: the dead are coming at the bunker in formation, like soldiers. I'm putting together a rapid response group, and you lead it. The bunker is theirs, we only help them hold it. First the dead, and the Monolith never lets a fight like that pass. Fifty thousand.
Clear Sky: the group is on its way to the bunker. They will come in about %d h. Take positions with the scientists!
Clear Sky: the dead are at the bunker! Cover the scientists!
Clear Sky: the first wave is down - more dead are coming! Hold!
Clear Sky: the bunker held, the scientists are alive. Reward: %d RU.
Clear Sky: the bunker has fallen... Fall back to the factory.
The Checkpoint

The checkpoint on Jupiter. Whoever holds it holds the way to Pripyat - and right now that's the Monolith, their best fighters, a lot of them. Five squads go with you. When it falls they will come back within minutes - be ready. Then it's our northern base: Kholodny takes command. Ninety thousand.
Clear Sky: the squads are moving to Jupiter. Muster point - %s.
Clear Sky: go, to %s! Take the checkpoint.
Clear Sky: sector clear. Next - %s.
Clear Sky: the Monolith is back! Hold the checkpoint!
Clear Sky: they broke. The checkpoint stays ours.
Clear Sky: the Jupiter checkpoint is ours - our northern base. Reward: %d RU.
Clear Sky: the checkpoint is lost. Fall back.
Clear Sky: Kholodny, a medic, a trader, a mechanic and a barman set out for %s under escort.
Clear Sky: our people are at %s. The north has a Clear Sky base now.
Viking

Clear Sky's boss at the Agroprom factory, callsign Viking. A big quiet man who never wears a helmet - says he wants to see the Zone with his own eyes. Ran Clear Sky's technical side for years; now runs the base, the expeditions and the war.
Arsenal
Clear Sky's trader at the Agroprom factory, callsign Arsenal. Knows every gun that ever came through the swamps by its serial number. Sits at his table under the lamp and never forgets a debt.
Kompas
Clear Sky's trader by the scientists' bunker on Yantar, callsign Kompas. Works with Sakharov's people: weapons, ammo and food for Clear Sky and for everyone who walks north past Yantar.
Special Tools
Viking needs tools: %s.
Our techs are rebuilding the factory's workshop. They need proper tools, not the junk the army left. Bring what's on the list.
Bring: %s.
Now we can work. The workshop thanks you.
Rare Mechanisms
Viking needs rare mechanisms: %s.
Our instruments are old and the Zone eats electronics. I need rare parts - the kind you only find in stashes or on the dead.
Bring: %s.
Exactly what we needed. The instruments will live another year.
Papers from Below
Bring Viking the documents from the NII Agroprom underground.
Under the NII Agroprom there are tunnels, and in them - the research the army never took out. Whoever goes down there first gets it. Make sure it's us.
That's it. Years of work - back where it belongs.
Mutants at the Walls
Destroy the mutant pack near the factory.
A pack has settled right at our walls. The sentries can't sleep and the expeditions can't go out. Clear it.
Quiet now. The expeditions can go out again.
The Hunt
Destroy the mutant pack in the marked area.
Our scouts found a big pack on the next level. It will come to us sooner or later - better we come to it first.
Good hunt. The scouts will sleep tonight.
Lost Research
Viking is looking for research papers: %s.
Some of the Zone's research ended up in stashes all over the place. I want it back for our scientists.
Find: %s. Look in the rich stashes.
That's it. The scientists will be up all night.
Wild Territory
Destroy the mutant pack in the marked area.
The Wild Territory is full of things that eat travellers. Our road runs past it. Thin them out.
The road is safer. The scientists say thanks.
Road Robbers
Destroy the bandit group in the marked area.
Bandits are waiting for our convoys near the Wild Territory. One convoy lost is a week without supplies. Clear them out.
The convoys will get through now.
Big Supply Run
Kompas needs supplies: %s.
The group out on the road eats a lot and bleeds a lot. I need supplies, and a lot of them.
Bring: %s.
That will keep the boys going for a while. Here's your pay.
Medicine for the Road
Kompas needs medicine: %s.
The scientists' expeditions come back torn up. I need medicine - a full crate of it.
Bring: %s.
Good. Fewer graves along the road.
Rations
Kompas needs food: %s.
Twenty people at the post and every one of them hungry. Food, lots of it.
Bring: %s.
Now we can hold out for a month.
Samples for the Scientists
Kompas needs an artifact: %s.
The scientists we work with need samples for their measurements. Not for sale - for science.
Bring: %s.
That's the one. The scientists will be happy.
Rare Trophies
Kompas needs mutant parts: %s.
The scientists study the big ones - chimeras, burers, controllers. They need parts, fresh and whole.
Bring: %s.
Fresh and whole. The scientists will owe us.
%s: reinforcements are coming - %d squads, to %s. Hold on!
The attack will come from here
Attackers
Scientists (radio): Clear Sky, anyone! Our sensors on Yantar show something we've never seen - a group of strange dead, moving together, in formation. They're coming at the bunker. Please!
Viking: You heard them. Rapid response group - get ready, move to Yantar, hold the bunker with the scientists. They are under our protection now.
Scientists (radio): Clear Sky... we don't know how to thank you. Our people are alive because of you. From now on our door is always open for you - samples, data, anything you need.
Clear Sky: the third wave of the dead! Last push - hold the bunker!
Clear Sky: the dead are down - and here comes the Monolith! Hold the bunker!
Salazar
Clear Sky's trader at the Jupiter checkpoint, callsign Salazar. Came north with Kholodny's group; deals in weapons and supplies for everyone who holds the way to Pripyat.
Kruger

Clear Sky's mechanic at the Jupiter checkpoint, callsign Kruger. Came north with Kholodny's group and set up his workbench in the corner; repairs and upgrades weapons and armour for everyone who holds the way to Pripyat.
Racuro
Clear Sky's medic at the Jupiter checkpoint, callsign Racuro. Patches up whoever comes back from the north and sells what keeps the next ones alive.
Fin
Clear Sky's cook at the Jupiter checkpoint, callsign Fin. Keeps the pot on the fire by the wall and trades food and drink to the garrison.
Heart of the Oasis
Kholodny needs a legendary artifact: %s.

There is an artifact our geophysicists have only read about - the Heart of the Oasis. It is born where the Zone hides its quietest places. If one ever falls into your hands, do not take it to a trader. Bring it here, and Clear Sky will pay better than anyone.
Bring: %s.
So it does exist... Careful, put it into the container. You have just given the lab a year of work. Here is your pay, and it is honest pay.
The Compass
Kholodny needs a legendary artifact: %s.

They say the Compass shows a way through any anomaly field. We do not need the legend, we need the readings: an artifact that feels the gaps between anomalies would rewrite half of our maps. Find one and bring it to me.
Bring: %s.
The Compass. I thought I would never hold one. Our guides will owe you their lives without ever knowing it. Take your pay.
The Emerald
Kholodny needs a legendary artifact: %s.

The Monolith carries green stones from the far north - the Volat Emerald. It dampens the anomalies around it, and nobody outside their sect knows how. I want one on our table. Where you take it from is your business.
Bring: %s.
Green, cold, and the instruments have gone mad already. That is the one. Clear Sky does not forget such things - here is your pay.
Rare Sample
Kholodny needs a rare artifact: %s.

The lab has moved on from the common samples. Now it wants the rare ones - what the fields give out once in a few emissions. I have a specific request from the geophysicists, and I pay well above the traders.
Bring: %s.
A clean specimen. The geophysicists are already fighting over who gets it first. Here is your pay.
Sortie into the Fields
Go out into the anomaly fields and bring Kholodny an artifact: %s.
I need a man for a sortie. After the last emission the fields around here have shifted, and the lab wants a fresh artifact from them - a specific kind. Go out, find it, come back alive.
Bring from the sortie: %s.
Back in one piece, and with the goods. A good sortie. Here is your pay.
Measurements by the Checkpoint
Take measurements at an anomaly near the checkpoint for Kholodny.
Kholodny asked me to take measurements in an anomaly field, but I have lost the $item_1. I need to get it back first.
Kholodny asked me to take measurements at an anomaly not far from the checkpoint.\nI need to get to the marked place.
I am at the anomaly. I need to take the $item_1 in hand and wait until the measurement is complete.
The measurements are taken. I can return to Kholodny with the $item_1 and the readings.

The fields around the checkpoint breathe, and I want to know how. Take our detector, walk up to the anomaly I mark for you, hold the device in your hand and wait until it has recorded everything. Mind your back: the local wildlife likes to come and see what is beeping.
The readings are clean. One more point on our map of the fields. Here is your pay.
Field Survey
Take measurements for Kholodny at the anomaly his survey points to.
Kholodny asked me to take measurements in an anomaly field, but I have lost the $item_1. I need to get it back first.
Kholodny asked me to take measurements at an anomaly from his survey list - it may be close by or in a neighbouring area.\nI need to get to the marked place.
I am at the anomaly. I need to take the $item_1 in hand and wait until the measurement is complete.
The measurements are taken. I can return to Kholodny with the $item_1 and the readings.

One point is not science. To see how the fields are linked I need readings from all around - our own fields, Zaton, the Red Forest, wherever the survey list points this time. The walk may be long, so the pay is higher. Take the detector and bring it back with the record.
Not for nothing: these numbers match ours. The fields are linked after all. Here is your pay.
Sortie: Jupiter Fields
Place Kholodny's scanner in an anomaly field of Jupiter.

A sortie, and not a quiet one. I am giving you a scanner. Carry it into the heart of the anomaly field I mark on your map, set it up there and come back. It will send us the readings by itself for as long as it lives. Fields like that do not let strangers in for free, so watch every step.
The signal is coming in. The scanner is where it should be. A clean sortie - here is your pay.
Sortie: Zaton Fields
Place Kholodny's scanner in an anomaly field of Zaton.

This sortie is a long one. Zaton has fields that have no equals here: the Claw, the Iron Forest, the Scar. I want our scanner in one of them. Take the device, get to the field I mark, set it up and come back. I pay for the road as well.
Zaton is on the air. Now we see the swamps there as if they were our own. Here is your pay, you have earned it.
Courier: Artifacts for Viking
Carry the case with the artifacts from Kholodny to Viking at the Agroprom factory.
Kholodny has cargo for Viking: the $item_1. I do not have it on me - I need to take it.
I am carrying the $item_1 from Kholodny. It must be handed to Viking in person, at the Clear Sky factory on Agroprom.

Over these weeks the checkpoint has gathered a whole case of artifacts, and all of it must go south, to Viking's big lab at the factory. It is heavy, it is worth a fortune, and half the Zone would kill for it. I need a courier I can trust. Hand it to Viking personally - he will pay you on the spot.
Good work, courier.
Viking, a case from the north. Artifacts from $name, the whole batch.
From Kholodny? Sealed, and the weight is right. So the northern lab really works. You carried a fortune across the whole Zone and did not open it - I value that. Here is your pay.
Courier: Archive for Viking
Carry the checkpoint's field archive from Kholodny to Viking at the Agroprom factory.
Kholodny has cargo for Viking: the $item_1. I do not have it on me - I need to take it.
I am carrying the $item_1 from Kholodny. It must be handed to Viking in person, at the Clear Sky factory on Agroprom.

Measurement logs, maps of the fields, reports on the Monolith - a month of our work, on paper and on drives. I will not send this over the radio: too many ears. Take the archive to Viking at the factory and put it into his hands. He pays on delivery.
Good work, courier.
Viking, the archive from the Jupiter checkpoint. $name said to hand it to you only.
At last. I have been waiting for these papers longer than for the spring. The scientists will sort them out, and you take your pay - you have earned it.
Courier: Supplies for the North
Carry the crate of supplies from Viking to Kholodny at the Jupiter checkpoint.
Viking has cargo for Kholodny: the $item_1. I do not have it on me - I need to take it.
I am carrying the $item_1 from Viking. It must be handed to Kholodny in person, at the Clear Sky checkpoint on Jupiter.

Kholodny's people sit at the very edge of the map, and no caravan will go there. Medicine, rations, anti-rad, batteries for the instruments - it is all packed in one crate, and it is heavy. Carry it to the Jupiter checkpoint and hand it to Kholodny. He will pay you there.
Good work, courier.
Kholodny, a crate from the south. Supplies from $name.
From Viking? Just in time: we were down to the last pack of anti-rad. The garrison will remember your name. Here is your pay.
Courier: Weapons for the North
Carry the crate of weapons from Viking to Kholodny at the Jupiter checkpoint.
Viking has cargo for Kholodny: the $item_1. I do not have it on me - I need to take it.
I am carrying the $item_1 from Viking. It must be handed to Kholodny in person, at the Clear Sky checkpoint on Jupiter.

The Monolith tests the checkpoint every week, and Kholodny's barrels are wearing out. Arsenal has put together a crate: rifles, spare parts, ammunition. It weighs like a dead boar, and you must not be caught with it by the military. Carry it north and hand it to Kholodny personally.
Good work, courier.
Kholodny, a crate from the factory. Weapons and ammunition from $name.
Now that is a gift. The next Monolith squad is in for a surprise. Thank Viking for me, and take your pay.
Sealed case with artifacts
A heavy shielded case with Clear Sky seals: a large batch of artifacts collected at the Jupiter checkpoint. Addressed to Viking at the Agroprom factory. Do not open.
Field archive of the checkpoint
A sealed folder and data drives: measurement logs, maps of the anomaly fields and reports of the Jupiter checkpoint. Addressed to Viking at the Agroprom factory.
Crate of supplies for the checkpoint
Medicine, rations, anti-rad and batteries for the instruments, packed at the Agroprom factory. Addressed to Kholodny at the Jupiter checkpoint.
Crate of weapons for the checkpoint
Rifles, spare parts and ammunition from Arsenal's stock at the Agroprom factory. Addressed to Kholodny at the Jupiter checkpoint. Very heavy.

Zone Operations (Mixon)
Triage
Racuro needs medicine for the wounded of the checkpoint: %s.

Every night somebody comes back from the fields with holes in him, and my shelf is empty. Bandages I can still boil, but the rest... Bring me what I ask for. Not for me - for the boys on the cots behind that curtain.
Bring: %s.
That's exactly what I needed. Two of them will be on their feet by morning. Here, take this - and try not to end up on my table yourself.
Perishable
Carry Racuro's serum to Kompas at the scientists' bunker on Yantar within a day and a half.

The scientists on Yantar asked for my serum - the one against the psy-burns from the north. It keeps for a day and a half, no more, and then it is just coloured water. Kompas, our trader by the bunker, will take it to them. Go now, and don't stop for artefacts on the way.
Kompas has the serum. The scientists owe Clear Sky one more favour.
A Pot for Everyone
Fin needs raw meat for the garrison's kitchen: %s.

Twenty men, one pot and tins that taste of the tin. Kholodny says a soldier fights on what he eats. So bring me meat - real meat, from the mutants out there. I'll cook it so you won't recognise it. That's a compliment.
Bring: %s.
Now that's a stew in the making. Here's your pay, and a little of what's left from last time - still warm.
The Lost Wagon
Find the gang that took the checkpoint's food and wipe it out. Then report to Fin.

Our food came up from the south on a cart with two boys, and the cart never got here. The boys did - barefoot and without a single tin. Some gang has made camp on our provisions. Find them, take back what's left, and tell me when it's done. I'll make sure you never eat from a tin here again.
So they had a feast on our food. Their last one. Here - a little something from the kitchen.
%s: the gang (%s) that took our food is camping near %s. Get it back.
Racuro's serum
A cold-packed case of ampoules against psy-burns, made by Racuro at the Jupiter checkpoint. Keeps a day and a half. Addressed to Kompas at the scientists' bunker on Yantar.

Clean Field

Listen up. My boys picked up an army channel: there's spetsnaz sitting in the Administration, and it's no patrol. Their operation is called Clean Field, and the target is us. They'll hit the HQ five minutes after they figure out we know. We hold the base to the last man, I'll send reinforcements. If we hold, we go take the Administration. Sixty thousand for the defense, ninety more for the assault.
